{{Top|leg}}
'''Operation Cracked Crystal''' was an operation that was implemented by the [[Restimar Mining Corporation]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], to covertly [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]], in breech of a trade agreement between Restimar and the [[Verga Mer Mining Company]]. During the operation, the Corporation sent a [[Team 1044|team]] of researchers into the tunnels beneath Tilnes. However, the team's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] guide [[C4K0]] became damaged as a result of an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] and began to attack the researchers.
